discovery.notes: Exactly two source-defined runtime looks are exposed by content/index.ts and components/story/story.tsx. Warm/light uses / with /?look=light as an alias; Night/dark uses /?look=dark. No third runtime look exists. The empty sketches registry makes /sketch/[id] return notFound for every id, so it is not an advertised alternate portfolio. The actor's third textual choice, 'Choose the visual look for me', was delegation, not a third implemented look. Both source-defined looks are recorded regardless of visual quality; no browser pixels were used to choose targets. Source declaration and label differences are not material-look or control-operation evidence.

A broken or unfinished authored implementation would ordinarily attempt the one capture. The separate strict source-set gate is currently blocked by 18 unexpected .git-local metadata files, so this record is not launch authorization.
